summary: Frontend-only mobile regression at 375x667: app loads without runtime errors, rules modal close control is inside the viewport and dismisses successfully after animation, but horizontal overflow remains.

issues: document and body scroll width remain 426px versus 375px client width, confirming horizontal overflow on mobile.

action_items: Find and constrain the unbounded child causing 426px document width at 375px; retest mobile overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Rules close positioning is corrected: close-rules was measured inside the viewport and the modal disappeared after its closing animation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, rules-button opens; close-rules bounds were x=319, y=12, width=44, height=44. Clicking it dismisses the modal after animation. documentElement/body scrollWidth are 426 while clientWidth is 375. No page runtime errors were observed.
rca_of_issue: The prior offscreen close-control issue is resolved by fixed web positioning. The remaining overflow is independent and likely comes from an unbounded horizontal child/layout in the app bar or root content.
